highlights.title: Come back to what your bots finished
highlights.text: When one bot finishes a job while you're away (its reply ends "Done: …"), it now shows in the Inbox under Done while you were away, titled with the request you gave it.

highlights.title: Notifications say stopped or blocked
highlights.text: While you're away, a bot that can't finish now tells you it stopped, and one waiting on you says it's blocked and why, instead of "replied" or nothing at all.

fixes: When the AI provider can't be reached, the reply names it ("Couldn't reach Anthropic from this computer") and says what to check.
Approval cards show folders in your home as ~/…, and Allow once leaves a short line in the chat where the bot asked.
A failed uv download for the Laya router now fails its own Install uv step, with the real error.
A lead's hand-off cards ("Delegated to …" and a follow-up to that teammate) now show in the team chat right away, without a reload.
